note: Daily put-call ratio, max pain and the call/put walls for Nifty and Bank Nifty, built from NSE F&O bhavcopy back to 2019. Open interest is summed across all expiries, so this is a trend series - it is not the same number as the nearest-expiry chain shown above.

cautions.all_expiries: Open interest is summed across every expiry. The nearest-expiry chain on the live card uses one expiry only, so the two will differ.
cautions.spot: Where the bhavcopy carried an underlying price it is used. Otherwise the real index close is joined from Yahoo, and the OI-derived strike is kept separately as oi_proxy_spot - it is not a price.
cautions.pcr_meaning: A high PCR can mean heavy put buying (bearish hedging) or heavy put writing (bullish). The number alone does not tell you which.
